metadata.language: English for generated caption, Chinese for instructions
metadata.default: Use one paragraph of full result scene caption

T2I.skeleton: [Medium and aesthetic]. [Number and appearance of subjects]. [Pose, object positions and interactions]. [Foreground, background and location]. [Framing, camera angle and lens perspective]. [Light and material description]. [Exact typography in quotes if needed].

EDIT.skeleton: In <ref_image_0>, the [main visible subject] remains [preserved appearance, pose and composition]. The [target] is now [replacement or changed property] while preserving [unchanged properties]. [Lighting, background, perspective and photo/style remain consistent].

MULTI_REF.skeleton: A cohesive [image medium] of [subject and action]. The person retains [identity properties] from <ref_image_0>; the clothing/design follows <ref_image_1>; the background follows <ref_image_2> if supplied. [Framing], [lighting] and [all other constraints].

LAYOUT_T2I.skeleton: A [scene medium] showing [subject/object] <obj_1> at [location], with [lighting and context]. Other elements <obj_2> [spatial relation] when their boxes exist.

LAYOUT_EDIT.skeleton: In <ref_image_0>, the original [person/scene] remains [preserved]. At <obj_1>, the [source item] has become [new item description]. [Lighting, geometry and other parts of the scene].

BENCHMARK.skeleton: One shared finalized caption for all compared branches, not one independent upsampling call per branch.
